1. (Currently amended) A method of cementing comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a carboxylated inulin __derived from chicory__; and allowing the cement composition to set.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 2 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures up to about 280 *F __and maintains a viscosity that remains substantially constant throughout the thickening time period__.

3. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about constant for a period of time after the cement composition is placed.

4. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein a suspension aid is not added to the cement composition.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition __at temperatures up to about 280 *F__.

6. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of about 500 or higher.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin __having a degree of substitution by carboxymethyl groups of from about 0.1 to about 0.3__.

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin __and no other retarder booster__.

10. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition further comprises borate salts, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group, or any combination thereof.

11. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a subterranean formation.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a wellbore __at a depth greater than 5,000 feet__.

13. (Currently amended) A method of cementing in a subterranean formation comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a carboxylated inulin __derived from chicory__; placing the cement composition in the subterranean formation; and allowing the cement composition to set therein.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 2 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures up to about 280 *F __and maintains a viscosity that remains substantially constant throughout the thickening time period__.

15. (Original) The method of claim 13 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about constant for a period of time after the cement composition is placed.

16. (Original) The method of claim 13 wherein a suspension aid is not added to the cement composition.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition __at temperatures up to about 280 *F__.

18. (Original) The method of claim 13 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of about 500 or higher.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin __having a degree of substitution by carboxymethyl groups of from about 0.1 to about 0.3__.

20. (Cancelled)

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin __and no other retarder booster__.

22. (Original) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition further comprises borate salts, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group, or any combination thereof.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition is placed in a wellbore __at a depth greater than 5,000 feet__.
